A new character: an amateur football player, a Japanese American man in his late sixties, a tough old tackler who has seen it all: short, compact and stocky with a firm flat stomach and a low centre of gravity, light golden-tan skin, narrow dark eyes under straight grey eyebrows, a broad flat face with high cheekbones and deep lines, a flat grey crew cut, a thin neat grey moustache, a stubborn jaw and a hard closed-mouth stare, thick smooth forearms and slightly bowed legs, wearing old navy blue sneakers. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour.
